verdict.rationale: 1Password's docs say it can store and quickly access one-time passwords when you turn on two-step verification for a website, and the Apple Watch app can look up one-time passwords. That evidences TOTP generation for new accounts, but nothing in the pack mentions scanning a QR code to set it up. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of QR-code scanning during setup, a documented flow showing codes are available immediately after scanning, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the TOTP setup experience.
